text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day on the training track, after our time
with <chrname> had reached a turning point.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'm gonna give it my all today too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You are overflowing with motivation today as well, Special Week-san.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I heard that seeing a friend run lit a fire inside her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Comrades, rivals, those we look up to...
There are countless times when such presences inspire and drive us forward, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: In other words, one could say such presence is indispensable to dash toward one's dreams.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: The sight of someone dashing earnestly toward their dream warms the hearts of onlookers and fills them with equal resolve, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, that's true.
Looking at Spe-chan, I feel that way too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now then, let us begin our training as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: So that we do not fall behind Special Week-san or the many others here striving diligently toward their dreams.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Horse Girls have dreams, and the sight of them running toward those dreams gives a push to someone else's back.
That, I thought, is why every race can ignite such burning passion.
